title: Sessions no person watches skip the hooks only a person reads, keeping the lease, asks and query-log rows
goal: A session started by backlog.py dispatch or begin, or a headless sprint runner started by the line the kb-sprint skill gives, runs as the operator's answer to the switch gate says; under the recommended answer the hooks a person reads (kb_hook, the change router, the session-start notices, the digest, horizon and intake hooks) exit at once in a session whose environment marks it unwatched, while coord_hook and the querylog capture and launch hooks run as before, so python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --arms A,worker shows the worker arm (arm A's hooks under bl_dispatch.worker_env's environment) starting fewer processes than arm A and still writing its coord session lease and query-log work rows

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A,worker', '--reps', '1', '--out', out],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load --arms A,worker exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
val = {(r['case'], r['arm'], r['metric']): float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load'}
for case in ('idle all', 'working all'):
    w, a = val.get((case, 'worker', 'spawns_per_min')), val.get((case, 'A', 'spawns_per_min'))
    assert w is not None and a is not None and w < a, ('a worker session starts no fewer processes than arm A', case, w, a)
assert val.get(('working all', 'worker', 'lease_written')) == 1, 'the worker session wrote no coord session lease'
assert val.get(('working all', 'worker', 'work_rows'), 0) > 0, 'the worker session wrote no query-log work rows'

gates.question: Should sessions no person watches (dispatched workers, headless sprint runners) run with fewer hooks, and which? Decide from the paid session-load record
options: Lean: person-only hooks exit, coord and query-log hooks kept
Lean plus coord and capture off
gates.recommendation: Lean: person-only hooks exit, coord and query-log hooks kept
